solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Phallocentrisim'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Phallocentrism'.**
 
• The word '**Phallocentrism**' is a **noun** which refers to a worldview or ideology that prioritizes masculine perspectives or male-centered viewpoints.
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• Her critique of the text focused on its overt phallocentrism.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Phallocentrisim'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let’s understand the meanings of the other marked words:**

 
• **Hermeneutics -** the theory and methodology of interpretation, especially of textual analysis **(व्याख्या-शास्त्र)**
 
• **Structuralism -** an intellectual movement emphasizing the relationships among elements of culture, language, and society **(संरचनावाद)**
 
• **Metafiction -** fiction that self-consciously examines the nature of storytelling **(आत्म-काल्पनिक साहित्य)**
